audit.method: Every enumerated blob read from the specified Git tree; remoteFetched identifies a fresh verification ref. Source byte counts and canonical UTF-8 LF/binary hashes checked. All frozen edition hashes checked. Each unique immutable Git archive blob is decompressed once; every logical original entry is compared to its verified compressed/raw byte counts and SHA-256. No mutable-file timestamp or runtime-proof shortcut.

scope: Actual non-force atomic main/edition096/tag push, then fetch and complete Git-tree verification. Receipt follows the frozen release without amending its tag. Source-qualified combined local method coverage does not predeclare the remote CI outcome; the original full invocation failed four subsequently corrected test-boundary assertions.
